022/**
023 * Verifiable code examples for StreamConverter documentation.
024 *
025 * <p>This class contains actual, compilable, and runnable code examples that are referenced from
026 * documentation. Each example is marked with START/END comments for potential extraction into
027 * documentation.
028 *
029 * <p>All examples in this file are tested to ensure they compile and execute correctly.
030 */
031public class BasicUsageExamples {
032
033  // [START csv-navigate-basic]
034  /**
035   * CSV navigation pipeline example - demonstrates pipeline structure with CSV column navigation.
036   * Note: Uses PassThroughRule (no transformation) and a lambda pass-through (placeholder for
037   * actual processing).
038   */
039  public void csvNavigateBasic() throws Exception {
040    // Sample CSV data
041    String csvData = "id,productName,price\n" + "1,Apple,100\n" + "2,Banana,50\n";
042    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
043    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
044
045    // Create pipeline: navigate CSV + process
046    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
047      CsvNavigateCommand.create(CSVPath.of("productName"), new PassThroughRule()),
048      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out)
049    };
050
051    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
052    converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
053  }
054
055  // [END csv-navigate-basic]
056

092      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out)
093    };
094
095    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
096    converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);

125  /**
126   * Character encoding conversion pipeline example - demonstrates charset conversion in a pipeline.
127   * Note: The lambda pass-through is a placeholder for actual processing logic.
128   */
129  public void characterConvertBasic() throws Exception {
130    String data = "Hello World";

133
134    // Create pipeline: convert encoding + process
135    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
136      CharacterConvertCommand.create("Shift_JIS", "UTF-8"),
137      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out)
138    };
139
140    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
141    converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);

147  /**
148   * Line ending normalization pipeline example - demonstrates line ending conversion in a pipeline.
149   * Note: The lambda pass-through is a placeholder for actual processing logic.
150   */
151  public void lineEndingNormalizeBasic() throws Exception {
152    String data = "Line 1\r\nLine 2\rLine 3\n";
153    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(data.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
154    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
155
156    // Create pipeline: normalize line endings + process
157    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
158      new LineEndingNormalizeCommand(LineEndingType.UNIX),
159      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out)
160    };
161
162    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
163    converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
164  }

168  // [START pipeline-simple]
169  /** Simple pipeline example - chaining multiple commands. */
170  public void simplePipeline() throws Exception {
171    String csvData = "id,name,price\n1,Apple,100\n";
172    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes("Shift_JIS"));
173    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
174
175    // CSV → Character conversion → Output
176    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
177      CsvNavigateCommand.create(CSVPath.of("name"), new PassThroughRule()),
178      CharacterConvertCommand.create("Shift_JIS", "UTF-8")
179    };
180
181    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
182    converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
183  }
184
185  // [END pipeline-simple]
186
187  // [START error-handling-basic]
188  /**
189   * Error handling pipeline example - demonstrates exception-based error detection. Note: The
190   * lambda pass-through is a placeholder for actual processing logic.
191   */
192  public void errorHandlingBasic() throws Exception {
193    String csvData = "id,name\n1,Apple\n";
194    InputStream inputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(csvData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
195    OutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
196
197    // Create pipeline for error handling demonstration
198    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
199      CsvNavigateCommand.create(CSVPath.of("name"), new PassThroughRule()),
200      (IStreamCommand) (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out)
201    };
202
203    StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(pipeline);
204    try {
205      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
206    } catch (StreamProcessingException e) {
207      System.err.println("Pipeline failed: " + e.getMessage());
208      throw e;
209    }
210  }
211  // [END error-handling-basic]
212}
